# hetznerrobot_failover (Resource)

Routes a failover IP (or failover subnet) to a server. The IP must be configured on every server it can be switched to. **Destroying the resource deletes the routing** — the failover IP then reaches no server until it is routed again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server" "primary" {
  server_number = 321
}

# Switch the failover IP by changing active_server_ip. Destroying the resource
# deletes the routing — the IP then reaches no server.
resource "hetznerrobot_failover" "vip" {
  ip               = "88.99.1.10"
  active_server_ip = data.hetznerrobot_server.primary.server_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `active_server_ip` (String) Main IP of the server the failover IP is routed to. For an IPv6 failover subnet, the net address of the target server's main IPv6 subnet.
- `ip` (String) Failover IP, or net address of a failover subnet.

### Read-Only

- `netmask` (String) Netmask of the failover IP.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP of the server the failover IP was ordered for.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of that server.
- `server_number` (Number) Number of that server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_failover.vip 88.99.1.10
```
